picks.headline: Initial Audio releases Difro Melody AI, a FREE AI MIDI generator
picks.excerpt: Initial Audio's Difro Melody AI is a standalone neural MIDI generator for macOS and Windows that reharmonises and reimagines your own MIDI using a local Variational Autoencoder plus Transformer model. It runs fully offline on CPU or GPU; the free tier allows 50 generations a month, with a $49 Pro tier for unlimited use.
picks.rationale: A free, fully offline neural MIDI generator that works on the producer's own material — installable today, no cloud, no licensing question.

picks.headline: Suno admits it obtained YouTube audio to train its AI – but challenges UMG and Sony's standing on the 'stream ripping' claim
picks.excerpt: In its answer to UMG and Sony Music's amended complaint, Suno concedes it obtained audio from YouTube to train earlier models while disputing the labels' standing to bring a stream-ripping claim — a direct look at where the training data for the tools producers now use came from.
picks.rationale: A court filing, not a press release: Suno concedes on the record how earlier models were fed, which is the provenance question every client asks before signing off AI-assisted music.

picks.headline: AI Music Disputes Need More Than a Label: 5 Records All Artists Should Keep
picks.excerpt: As streaming platforms move to label AI-generated tracks, a label alone won't settle a dispute. The piece lays out five records artists should keep as they work with AI tools: consent documentation, source files, version histories, revenue trails, and any challenges to unauthorised use.
picks.rationale: Turns the AI-disclosure wave into a concrete paperwork checklist — the one item here that changes a working musician's filing habits tomorrow.

picks.headline: Tone3000 has launched a free open-source plugin that puts hundreds of thousands of NAM A2 device captures at your fingertips
picks.excerpt: Tone3000 released a free, open-source plugin (standalone + VST3/AU) that opens up hundreds of thousands of community-made Neural Amp Modeler A2 captures, with a Chains feature for stacking amp, cab and IR captures. Neural amp modelling moves from niche DIY tooling to a free, library-scale tone workflow.
picks.rationale: Neural amp modelling goes free and open-source at library scale — a whole tone-design workflow you can install tonight, with community-trained captures stacked in chains inside the DAW.

picks.headline: Positive Grid announce the Spark Pedal
picks.excerpt: Positive Grid squeezed its Spark amp platform into a stompbox with 33 amp models, 43 effects and access to 100,000+ community tones, backed by a companion app with Text to Tone — describe a phrase, song, artist or feeling and get matching tone suggestions — plus real-time Auto Chords. Prompt-driven tone design arrives as a pedal, not a plugin.
picks.rationale: Text to Tone puts prompt-driven sound design on the floor of a guitar rig — the clearest example yet of an AI interface being physicalised into hardware creatives already use.
